description.value: You install and remove your own augments without a licensed shop, at no increase in risk, and your install and removal recovery periods are reduced by 1 day (minimum 1). You may carry one augment of a Grade one band above the one your character level allows, and your Drift from that augment is counted at double. The back room stops being necessary; the price of that is written into you rather than paid at the counter.

cinderfall.incomplete: Self-installing/removing augments, the 1-day (minimum 1) recovery reduction, carrying an augment one Grade band above the level cap, and double-counted Drift are all built on Cinderfall's own augment-economy bookkeeping (install/removal downtime, Grade, Drift) -- none of it exists anywhere in the actor schema for a rule element to read or modify.
